title: The valve that decides how bad a burst pipe gets

scenes.text: When a pipe bursts, water comes out at several gallons a minute.
scenes.voice: When a pipe bursts, water comes out at several gallons a minute.

scenes.text: The difference between a $300 repair and a $30,000 insurance claim is how fast you can stop it.
scenes.voice: The difference between a three hundred dollar repair and a thirty thousand dollar insurance claim is how fast you can stop it.

scenes.text: The main shutoff sits where the water line enters your house. Usually on the wall facing the street, near the water meter.
scenes.voice: The main shutoff sits where the water line enters your house. Usually on the wall facing the street, near the water meter.

scenes.text: Turn it, and everything downstream stops.
